The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his own blood - causing far greater pain than he himself feels.
Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.

Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.
Burning Spears launches an additional %multishot_targets% spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_huskar_bio:
Emerging from the throes of the sacred Nothl Realm, Huskar opened his eyes to see the prodigal shadow priest Dazzle working a deep incantation over him. Against the ancient rites of the Dezun Order, Huskar's spirit had been saved from eternity, but like all who encounter the Nothl he found himself irrevocably changed. No longer at the mercy of a mortal body, his very lifeblood became a source of incredible power; every drop spilled was returned tenfold with a fierce, burning energy. However this newfound gift infuriated Huskar, for in his rescue from the Nothl, Dazzle had denied him a place among the gods. He had been denied his own holy sacrifice.

In time the elders of the order sought to expand their influence and Huskar, they agreed, would be a formidable tool in their campaign. Yet becoming a mere weapon for the order that denied him his birthright only upset him further. As the first embers of war appeared on the horizon, he fled his ancestral home to find new allies, all the while seeking a cause worthy of unleashing the power his total sacrifice could bring.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_huskar_hype: As his health lowers, Huskar's ability to slay enemies grows considerably. Able to instantly remove a portion of both his and an enemy's health with his ultimate, when near death he is able to throw his burning spears with devastating speed.

qualifications.raw:
[[Roshan]] is innately immune to all forced movement sources.

However, other ability components still apply.

While leaping, Huskar is debuff immune and has increased magic resistance.

Huskar also draws upon his health upon breaking the affected target's health.

{{Tauntcard}}

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Applies a {{M|basic dispel}} on Huskar upon cast.
** {{Symbol|Caster|Leap}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** Launches and periodically moves Huskar at {{#var:Life Break basic2}}-speed with the {{M|projectile}} upon cast.
*** Can move Huskar over {{M|impassable terrain}} and over {{M|trees}}.
*** Grants the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|huskar_life_break_charge}}, and applies the following ability effects:
**** {{M|Disarm}}
**** {{M|Debuff immunity}}.
**** Bonus {{M|magic resistance}}.
***** Stacks multiplicatively with other magic resistance sources.
**** {{Symbol|Turn Rate|Lock}}
***** Does not lock his {{M|facing angle}}.
*** The following offensive sources interrupt the leap, and nullifies the ability cast:
**** {{M|Disable}} sources.
**** {{M|Forced movement}} sources (including from allies).
**** {{M|Teleport}} sources.

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
** All Life Break ability effects on both Huskar and the affected enemy unit upon projectile impact.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Upon reaching the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy:
**** {{M|Dispels}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|huskar_life_break_charge}}.
**** Removes the Life Break {{M|projectile}}.

* {{Symbol|Caster|Leap}} [[File:Dota2 Pto.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 toP.png|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} 
** When the distance between the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy and Huskar is {{Code|> {{#var:Life Break value6}}-distance}} at any time during the leap, the leap component is canceled.
*** However, the projectile is not destroyed.
*** Huskar will stop in place, frozen in his leap animation. He can be given move orders in this state.
*** After a short while, the Current Health as Damage components, slows {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{ValueColor||and taunt|agh}} will be applied, and Huskar finally lands.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Checks if Huskar has the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} while being launched along with the projectile.
** {{Symbol|Taunt}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** [[Taunts]] the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy upon cast, forcing it to attack Huskar.
*** Does not apply {{M|silence}}.

***# {{Symbol|mp cost}} {{to}} {{Symbol|hp cost}}

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Checks for Huskar's {{M|current health}} per {{M|server tick}}.
** Grants all ability bonuses exponentially based on the percentage difference between Huskar's max and current health, ramping up faster the lower the current health percentage.
*** {{cf|expr}}
**** {{Code|[[Health|CurrentHP]] ≤ {{#var:Berserker's Blood value1}}}}, grants max bonus ability values.
**** {{Code|CurrentHP {{=}} 100%}}, does not grant any bonuses.

* Stacks multiplicatively with other {{M|magic resistance}} sources.
<hr>
* {{cf|shdnotes}} Adds an active component that applies the following ability effects upon cast:
** Applies a {{M|basic dispel}}.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|huskar_cauterize_delay (x)}} {{to}} {{Symbol|bonus hprestore}}
*** The ability stores the amount of health that Huskar will [[heal]], and is defined as:
**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Heal {{=}} ( {{ValueColor||30%|shd|x}} × Current[[Health|HP]] ) + {{ValueColor||{{#var:Berserker's Blood type2 value2 shd}}|shd|x}} × MaxHP × Debuff[[Dispel|Dispelled]])}}
*** The value on the [[HUD]] is affected by {{M|heal manipulation}}, the value before manipulation will be shown on the buff icon and above Huskar upon heal proc.
*** {{ValueColor||{{#var:Berserker's Blood type2 value1 shd}}|shd}} seconds after casting, applies the total self heal as one single instance.
**** Applies the heal even when Huskar is {{M|hidden}} or {{M|invulnerable}}.
**** Recasting the ability applies an independent heal buff.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_huskar
data.bio_loc:
Emerging from the throes of the sacred Nothl Realm, Huskar opened his eyes to see the prodigal shadow priest Dazzle working a deep incantation over him. Against the ancient rites of the Dezun Order, Huskar's spirit had been saved from eternity, but like all who encounter the Nothl he found himself irrevocably changed. No longer at the mercy of a mortal body, his very lifeblood became a source of incredible power; every drop spilled was returned tenfold with a fierce, burning energy. However this newfound gift infuriated Huskar, for in his rescue from the Nothl, Dazzle had denied him a place among the gods. He had been denied his own holy sacrifice.

In time the elders of the order sought to expand their influence and Huskar, they agreed, would be a formidable tool in their campaign. Yet becoming a mere weapon for the order that denied him his birthright only upset him further. As the first embers of war appeared on the horizon, he fled his ancestral home to find new allies, all the while seeking a cause worthy of unleashing the power his total sacrifice could bring.
data.hype_loc: As his health lowers, Huskar's ability to slay enemies grows considerably. Able to instantly remove a portion of both his and an enemy's health with his ultimate, when near death he is able to throw his burning spears with devastating speed.
data.npe_desc_loc: Sacrifices his health to deal more damage

abilities.name: huskar_burning_spear
abilities.desc_loc: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
abilities.lore_loc: The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his own blood - causing far greater pain than he himself feels.
notes_loc: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.
abilities.scepter_loc: Burning Spears launches an additional %multishot_targets% spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.
facets_loc: Burning Spears also burns enemies for a percentage of their max health. Costs Max Health instead of Current Health.

abilities.name: huskar_berserkers_blood
abilities.desc_loc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
abilities.lore_loc: After losing his birthright, Huskar gained a lethality in physical combat that is only heightened as his own blood is spilled.
notes_loc: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.
abilities.shard_loc:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
facets_loc:
Berserker's Blood can be activated for a health cost. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: huskar_blood_magic
abilities.desc_loc:
Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.

Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

abilities.name: huskar_life_break
abilities.desc_loc:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore_loc: No matter the danger, Huskar thrusts himself into melees that only he can survive.
notes_loc: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
abilities.scepter_loc: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
facets_loc: Life Break also slows enemies in a radius around the target.
Life Break also heals friendly units in a radius around the target.

officialDataset.interpretation: Official website declarations, retained in full; not an assertion of complete engine verification.
